citation.journal: Journal of Clinical and Aesthetic Dermatology

cited_by.title: Hair shedding after pregnancy, illness or stress

record.population: 200 women with postpartum hair loss, Egypt
record.finding: Only 9.5% had telogen effluvium alone; 56.0% also had androgenetic alopecia, 6.5% also had traction alopecia and 28.0% had all three. The authors say postpartum telogen effluvium may be associated with other hair loss disorders.
record.note: Egyptian clinic sample, not African American or British Black women.
